text: Amnesty International reports that Qatar's migrant workers remain exposed to exploitation despite kafala reform and that expression and assembly are tightly restricted - the record of the state whose sovereign wealth fund (QIA) owns QSI, Braga's minority shareholder.
short: Amnesty: Qatar migrant-worker exploitation and restricted expression (country report)
